Summary

COACTVWC is an online CICS program that accepts and processes Account View requests, allowing users to look up and display detailed account and associated customer information by entering an account number. The program validates the input account number, retrieves account data from the Card Cross-Reference file, Account Master file, and Customer Master file, then presents the consolidated account and customer details on screen. It is a main/driver program that handles navigation via PF keys, including returning to the calling program or main menu.
- **Execution Environment**: Online (CICS) - **Database Access**: VSAM/CICS Files - **MQ Calls**: No - **Module Type**: Main/Driver module
### Key Functionalities: 1: Program Entry and Context Initialization - Determine if this is a fresh entry or re-entry by checking communication area length and originating program. Initialize working storage and communication area accordingly to establish the correct processing context. 2: PF Key Validation - Validate the function key pressed by the user. Accept only Enter key or PF3 as valid inputs. If any other key is pressed, treat it as an Enter key press to continue normal processing. 3: Navigation to Previous Screen or Main Menu (PF3 Handler) - When user presses PF3, determine the calling program and transaction. If no calling program is identified, navigate to the main menu; otherwise, return control to the originating program, passing updated communication area. 4: Display Initial Account View Screen - When the program is entered for the first time (fresh entry), display a blank Account View screen prompting the user to enter an account number to display. 5: Screen Header Initialization - Populate the screen header with application title, transaction ID, program name, current system date (MM/DD/YY format), and current system time (HH:MM:SS format). 6: Account Data Population on Screen - If account data was successfully retrieved, populate the screen with account details including: active status, current balance, credit limit, cash credit limit, current cycle credit, current cycle debit, open date, expiration date, reissue date, and group ID. 7: Customer Data Population on Screen - If customer data was successfully retrieved, populate the screen with customer details including: customer ID, SSN (formatted as XXX-XX-XXXX), FICO credit score, date of birth, first/middle/last name, address lines, city, state, zip code, country, phone numbers 1 and 2, government-issued ID, EFT account ID, and primary card holder indicator. 8: Screen Field Attribute and Color Setup - Set screen field attributes including cursor positioning on the account ID field. Apply red color highlighting to the account ID field when it contains an error or is blank during re-entry. Set informational message display color based on whether a message exists. 9: Receive User Input from Screen - Capture the data entered by the user on the Account View screen, specifically the account number input field. 10: Account Number Input Validation - Validate the account number entered by the user: (a) Check if account number is blank or not provided - set error message prompting for account number; (b) Check if account number is non-numeric or equals zero - set error message requiring an 11-digit non-zero numeric account number; (c) If valid, store the account number for further processing. 11: Cross-Field Validation - After individual field validation, check if no search criteria were provided at all (account filter is blank) and set appropriate 'No input received' message. 12: Account Card Cross-Reference Lookup - Look up the provided account ID in the Card Cross-Reference file using the account ID as the key. If found, retrieve and store the associated customer ID and card number. If not found, set an error message indicating the account was not found in the cross-reference file. 13: Account Master Data Retrieval - Read the Account Master file using the account ID to retrieve full account details. If found, mark account as found for screen display. If not found, set an error message indicating the account was not found in the account master file. 14: Customer Master Data Retrieval - Using the customer ID obtained from the card cross-reference, read the Customer Master file to retrieve full customer details. If found, mark customer as found for screen display. If not found, set an error message indicating the customer was not found in the customer master file. 15: Account View Processing Orchestration - Coordinate the complete account retrieval sequence: first look up the card cross-reference by account ID, then retrieve account master data, then retrieve customer master data. Stop processing and display error if any step fails. 16: Error Message Display and Screen Refresh - When input validation errors occur, display the Account View screen again with appropriate error messages highlighted in red, with the cursor positioned on the account ID field for correction. 17: Informational Message Management - Manage the informational message area on the screen: display 'Enter or update id of account to display' as a prompt when no info message exists, or display 'Displaying details of given Account' when account data is being shown. 18: Return Control with Communication Area - Package the communication area (including program context, last map/mapset used) and return control to the CICS transaction manager, specifying the current transaction ID so the screen remains active for further user interaction.

Datasource Information (3)

Datasource Name Type Usage
CXACAIX CICS FILE (Alternate Index) Read card cross-reference record by account ID to retrieve associated customer ID and card number
ACCTDAT CICS FILE Read account master record by account ID to retrieve account details such as balance, credit limit, status, and dates
CUSTDAT CICS FILE Read customer master record by customer ID to retrieve customer personal details such as name, address, SSN, date of birth, and contact information

## 1. Screen Initialization (1100-SCREEN-INIT) Clears the screen output area and populates the header fields with current date, time, transaction ID, and program name: ```cobol 1100-SCREEN-INIT. MOVE LOW-VALUES TO CACTVWAO MOVE FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE TO WS-CURDATE-DATA MOVE CCDA-TITLE01 TO TITLE01O OF CACTVWAO MOVE CCDA-TITLE02 TO TITLE02O OF CACTVWAO MOVE LIT-THISTRANID TO TRNNAMEO OF CACTVWAO MOVE LIT-THISPGM TO PGMNAMEO OF CACTVWAO MOVE FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE TO WS-CURDATE-DATA MOVE WS-CURDATE-MONTH TO WS-CURDATE-MM MOVE WS-CURDATE-DAY TO WS-CURDATE-DD MOVE WS-CURDATE-YEAR(3:2) TO WS-CURDATE-YY MOVE WS-CURDATE-MM-DD-YY TO CURDATEO OF CACTVWAO MOVE WS-CURTIME-HOURS TO WS-CURTIME-HH MOVE WS-CURTIME-MINUTE TO WS-CURTIME-MM MOVE WS-CURTIME-SECOND TO WS-CURTIME-SS MOVE WS-CURTIME-HH-MM-SS TO CURTIMEO OF CACTVWAO ``` ## 2. Screen Variable Setup (1200-SETUP-SCREEN-VARS) Populates all account and customer data fields on the screen, including account number, account details, and customer details: ```cobol 1200-SETUP-SCREEN-VARS. IF EIBCALEN = 0 SET WS-PROMPT-FOR-INPUT TO TRUE ELSE IF FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK MOVE LOW-VALUES TO ACCTSIDO OF CACTVWAO ELSE MOVE CC-ACCT-ID TO ACCTSIDO OF CACTVWAO END-IF IF FOUND-ACCT-IN-MASTER OR FOUND-CUST-IN-MASTER MOVE ACCT-ACTIVE-STATUS TO ACSTTUSO OF CACTVWAO MOVE ACCT-CURR-BAL TO ACURBALO OF CACTVWAO MOVE ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT TO ACRDLIMO OF CACTVWAO MOVE ACCT-CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT TO ACSHLIMO OF CACTVWAO MOVE ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT TO ACRCYCRO OF CACTVWAO MOVE ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT TO ACRCYDBO OF CACTVWAO MOVE ACCT-OPEN-DATE TO ADTOPENO OF CACTVWAO MOVE ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE TO AEXPDTO OF CACTVWAO MOVE ACCT-REISSUE-DATE TO AREISDTO OF CACTVWAO MOVE ACCT-GROUP-ID TO AADDGRPO OF CACTVWAO END-IF IF FOUND-CUST-IN-MASTER MOVE CUST-ID TO ACSTNUMO OF CACTVWAO STRING CUST-SSN(1:3) '-' CUST-SSN(4:2) '-' CUST-SSN(6:4) DELIMITED BY SIZE INTO ACSTSSNO OF CACTVWAO END-STRING MOVE CUST-FICO-CREDIT-SCORE TO ACSTFCOO OF CACTVWAO MOVE CUST-DOB-YYYY-MM-DD TO ACSTDOBO OF CACTVWAO MOVE CUST-FIRST-NAME TO ACSFNAMO OF CACTVWAO MOVE CUST-MIDDLE-NAME TO ACSMNAMO OF CACTVWAO MOVE CUST-LAST-NAME TO ACSLNAMO OF CACTVWAO MOVE CUST-ADDR-LINE-1 TO ACSADL1O OF CACTVWAO MOVE CUST-ADDR-LINE-2 TO ACSADL2O OF CACTVWAO MOVE CUST-ADDR-LINE-3 TO ACSCITYO OF CACTVWAO MOVE CUST-ADDR-STATE-CD TO ACSSTTEO OF CACTVWAO MOVE CUST-ADDR-ZIP TO ACSZIPCO OF CACTVWAO MOVE CUST-ADDR-COUNTRY-CD TO ACSCTRYO OF CACTVWAO MOVE CUST-PHONE-NUM-1 TO ACSPHN1O OF CACTVWAO MOVE CUST-PHONE-NUM-2 TO ACSPHN2O OF CACTVWAO MOVE CUST-GOVT-ISSUED-ID TO ACSGOVTO OF CACTVWAO MOVE CUST-EFT-ACCOUNT-ID TO ACSEFTCO OF CACTVWAO MOVE CUST-PRI-CARD-HOLDER-IND TO ACSPFLGO OF CACTVWAO END-IF END-IF IF WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE SET WS-PROMPT-FOR-INPUT TO TRUE END-IF MOVE WS-RETURN-MSG TO ERRMSGO OF CACTVWAO MOVE WS-INFO-MSG TO INFOMSGO OF CACTVWAO ``` ## 3. Screen Attribute Setup (1300-SETUP-SCREEN-ATTRS) Sets field attributes such as cursor position and color for the Account Number field and informational message: ```cobol 1300-SETUP-SCREEN-ATTRS. MOVE DFHBMFSE TO ACCTSIDA OF CACTVWAI EVALUATE TRUE WHEN FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK WHEN FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK MOVE -1 TO ACCTSIDL OF CACTVWAI WHEN OTHER MOVE -1 TO ACCTSIDL OF CACTVWAI END-EVALUATE MOVE DFHDFCOL TO ACCTSIDC OF CACTVWAO IF FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK MOVE DFHRED TO ACCTSIDC OF CACTVWAO END-IF IF FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK AND CDEMO-PGM-REENTER MOVE '*' TO ACCTSIDO OF CACTVWAO MOVE DFHRED TO ACCTSIDC OF CACTVWAO END-IF IF WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE MOVE DFHBMDAR TO INFOMSGC OF CACTVWAO ELSE MOVE DFHNEUTR TO INFOMSGC OF CACTVWAO END-IF ``` ## 4. Send Screen to Terminal (1400-SEND-SCREEN) Sends the populated BMS map to the user's terminal: ```cobol 1400-SEND-SCREEN. MOVE LIT-THISMAPSET TO CCARD-NEXT-MAPSET MOVE LIT-THISMAP TO CCARD-NEXT-MAP SET CDEMO-PGM-REENTER TO TRUE EXEC CICS SEND MAP(CCARD-NEXT-MAP) MAPSET(CCARD-NEXT-MAPSET) FROM(CACTVWAO) CURSOR ERASE FREEKB RESP(WS-RESP-CD) END-EXEC ``` ## 5. Receive Map Input from Terminal (2100-RECEIVE-MAP) Receives user input from the BMS screen into the input map area: ```cobol 2100-RECEIVE-MAP. EXEC CICS RECEIVE MAP(LIT-THISMAP) MAPSET(LIT-THISMAPSET) INTO(CACTVWAI) RESP(WS-RESP-CD) RESP2(WS-REAS-CD) END-EXEC ``` ## 6. Edit Map Inputs - Account Number Field (2200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS and 2210-EDIT-ACCOUNT) Reads and validates the Account Number field entered by the user: ```cobol 2200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS. SET INPUT-OK TO TRUE SET FLG-ACCTFILTER-ISVALID TO TRUE IF ACCTSIDI OF CACTVWAI = '*' OR ACCTSIDI OF CACTVWAI = SPACES MOVE LOW-VALUES TO CC-ACCT-ID ELSE MOVE ACCTSIDI OF CACTVWAI TO CC-ACCT-ID END-IF PERFORM 2210-EDIT-ACCOUNT THRU 2210-EDIT-ACCOUNT-EXIT IF FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK SET NO-SEARCH-CRITERIA-RECEIVED TO TRUE END-IF 2210-EDIT-ACCOUNT. SET FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK TO TRUE IF CC-ACCT-ID EQUAL LOW-VALUES OR CC-ACCT-ID EQUAL SPACES SET INPUT-ERROR TO TRUE SET FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK TO TRUE IF WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF SET WS-PROMPT-FOR-ACCT TO TRUE END-IF MOVE ZEROES TO CDEMO-ACCT-ID GO TO 2210-EDIT-ACCOUNT-EXIT END-IF IF CC-ACCT-ID IS NOT NUMERIC OR CC-ACCT-ID EQUAL ZEROES SET INPUT-ERROR TO TRUE SET FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK TO TRUE IF WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF MOVE 'Account Filter must be a non-zero 11 digit number' TO WS-RETURN-MSG END-IF MOVE ZERO TO CDEMO-ACCT-ID GO TO 2210-EDIT-ACCOUNT-EXIT ELSE MOVE CC-ACCT-ID TO CDEMO-ACCT-ID SET FLG-ACCTFILTER-ISVALID TO TRUE END-IF ``` ## 7. Error Message Population in COMMON-RETURN Moves the return/error message to the screen error message field before returning: ```cobol COMMON-RETURN. MOVE WS-RETURN-MSG TO CCARD-ERROR-MSG ```
